description: Read CodeRabbit reviews, repository settings, pull requests and usage.

coderabbit_new_pull_request_trigger.description: Runs for each new pull request in CodeRabbit. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, number, url, title, repository, state, draft, head_branch, head_owner, base_branch, head_sha, base_sha, updated_at

coderabbit_pull_request_head_changed_tri.description: Runs each time a pull request head changes in CodeRabbit. Changes made before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, number, url, title, repository, state, draft, head_branch, head_owner, base_branch, head_sha, base_sha, updated_at
